title: Frappe ERPNext 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.94.2 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have an authorization vulnerability in a supplier portal endpoint. The flaw arises because the party identity check does not differentiate between Customers and Suppliers sharing the same name. This allows authenticated users, including portal users or users without assigned roles, to craft requests that access buying-portal records outside their authorized scope.
